description:
Problem
BO channel pages contain fixed light-theme colors, so cards remain white and black text/icons lose contrast on dark surfaces. The user specifically reports Mattermost is difficult to identify in dark mode. Read-only Serena audit established the evidence below; browser verification remains required.

Scope
1. Shared components:
- lib/zaq_web/components/design_system/channel_connector_card.ex:43: replace fixed white surface, black text/borders, icon colors and enabled/disabled badge colors with design-system styling. Preserve all slots, IDs, events, selection and enable/edit behavior. Used by retrieval, SMTP, IMAP and Web Widget.
- lib/zaq_web/components/channel_capabilities.ex:19: theme trigger, modal body/title, supported/unsupported states and Close control.
- lib/zaq_web/components/connect_credential_form.ex:34: theme labels, inputs/selects, readonly/disabled states and actions.
- lib/zaq_web/components/channel_icons.ex:140,147: Mattermost SVG paths have fixed #1D325C; webhook at :171 has fixed #000000. Provide theme-aware monochrome icon colors or appropriate light variants in dark mode. Audit every provider icon on its actual backgrounds, including small category previews. Preserve multicolor brand identity; do not globally invert logos.

2. Page-specific markup:
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channels_index_live.html.heex: category/provider cards pass bg-white and black borders to CardShell (29,92,223); audit inline accents, actions and ingress-status modal.
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channels_live.html.heex: empty states, selectors, configuration/status panels, team/channel lists, message composer, thread/reply display, errors, config and credential modal bodies, OAuth/ingress status content, Clear Channel and Test Connection dialogs.
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/data_sources/provider_live.html.heex: summary/connector cards, empty state, controls and modal content, including shared credential form.
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_email_live.html.heex: SMTP/IMAP navigation cards and text.
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_smtp_live.html.heex and notification_imap_live.html.heex: settings panels/headers, labels, inputs, toggles, actions, feedback and test-message UI.
- lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/notification_logs_live.html.heex: search, table/rows, status indicators, detail modal and content panels.
- Web Widget uses many DS components already, but inherits ChannelConnectorCard and ChannelCapabilities defects. Verify shared changes there. Check channel history for regressions; avoid migrating already-correct DS markup unnecessarily.

Implementation guidance
Use Serena for source navigation (explicit user preference); follow docs/agent-tools.md and Context Mode for aggregate output. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, DESIGN.md, docs/bo-components.md, docs/code-quality.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/testing-approach.md, plus applicable design/design-migrate skills and Storybook contracts before affected work. Use existing semantic --zaq-* tokens and reusable DS components. Inspect actual cascade before claiming a hardcoded class wins. Reuse BOModal shells; theme caller-owned bodies. Avoid broad unrelated refactors, backend changes and duplicated components. Break implementation into durable child tasks/dependencies if required by workflow before coding.

Action reuse: not applicable — styling/icon contrast changes only; no executable operation, authorization, dispatch or persistence contract changes.

Acceptance and validation
- All scoped routes, cards, controls, empty/loading/error states and dialogs are readable in light and dark modes, including after LiveView updates.
- Mattermost and webhook are clearly identifiable on real dark backgrounds at normal and small preview sizes; inspect all other provider logos too.
- Semantic surfaces, text, borders, feedback, focus, hover, selected and disabled states adapt via data-zaq-theme, preserving light-mode appearance and brand identity. Meet DESIGN.md contrast requirements.
- Preserve routes, form submission/validation, connector lifecycle, IDs/events, authorization and modal behavior.
- Update relevant Storybook coverage and provide browser screenshots/evidence in both themes.
- Run mix q and focused component/LiveView tests, required existing E2E per workflow, and final mix precommit at the final gate. Obtain explicit approval before changing existing test behavior; follow human UX/E2E authoring gates where applicable. Record blockers rather than claiming unperformed verification.
This issue authorizes tracking only in the current session; implementation is for the agent taking the issue. No code has been changed.
title: [zaq-twk] Restore design-system dark theme across BO channel pages and icons
